mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_product (sku, name, price, stock, category, description) VALUES (CONCAT('APP-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')), #{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{category}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_product SET status = 'INACTIVE', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version = version + 1 WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, name, price, stock, category, description, created_at FROM catalog_product WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
